description: The social accounts the workspace tracks for new followers (x, bluesky, github): handle, follower count, new followers billed this month, poll state. A tracked account costs $2 a month; every new follower $0.008.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.
